{{Quote|Every ''Rebel'' on your planet must be placed in ''Imperial custody'' at once&hellip; or I will ''use'' the ''Volz Ion Ring'' to reduce your world to ''dead rock!''<nowiki></nowiki>|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bzorn]], to the people of [[Rion/Legends|Rion]]|<ref name="TSKR" />}}
The '''devastation of Rion''' was a battle of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==The devastation==
{{Quote|The most ''terrible'' thing happened! A weird ring-shaped ship ''demanded'' that every Rebel on Rion be ''arrested!'' When we ''refused,'' that dreadful ship did ''this'' to our climate! All of our food is ''frozen!'' People are ''starving&mdash;!''<nowiki></nowiki>|[[Tana (Human)|Tana]], to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="TSKR" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Rion/Legends|Rion]] was used as a base by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bzorn]] traveled to Rion aboard the [[Ionic Ring Ship|''Ionic Ring'']] and demanded that all Rebels on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] be arrested. When the people of Rion refused, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] shattered the environment of the planet, transforming it into a frozen wasteland. As a result, all the [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] on Rion was frozen and people began dying of starvation.<ref name="TSKR" />
